description: List available geo layers. Use to discover what data bharatlas has. Returns layer IDs, names, row counts, categories, realm (below, ground or air) and, for the layers the point lookups read, `lookups` ({ground: section, surface: section}: the section of ground_at or surface_at that reads the layer). Filter by category (boundaries, city-wards, environment, water, agriculture, transport, etc.), realm, admin level (state, district, block, village, etc.), source, or text search.

category.description: Filter by category: boundaries, city-wards, people, environment, water, agriculture, transport, infrastructure, health-edu, economy

level.description: Filter by admin level: state, district, subdistrict, block, village, etc.

q.description: Text search across layer IDs, sources, and descriptions

realm.description: Filter by realm: below (rocks, faults, minerals, aquifers, groundwater), ground (boundaries, wards, rivers, forests, roads, places), air (cyclone tracks)

source.description: Filter by data source: LGD, SOI, Bhuvan, OpenCity, DataMeet, etc.

name: list_layers
